description.label: Description
description.value: Your blade is as swift as lightning! You strike before your opponent even has time to react. As an Action, you may spend all your Advantage to attempt a single Unopposed Melee Test against your target, so long as your opponent is using a weapon without the Fast Quality. This action requires a Fast Quality weapon and sacrifices your Free Action and remaining Movement, if any, for the remainder of the turn if used.

tests.label: Tests
tests.value: Melee Test when using Lightning Strike talent
